title: Incremental Repo Review V1
description: repo-review needs a durable incremental review workflow for packages that have already received a full review. Oathweaver and OverCR are active target packages whose maintainer wants a CLI-driven maintenance workflow sooner than originally expected. The work must preserve staged review discipline while adding claim/evidence state, delta review, Drift Surfacer updates, and a narrow agent-native CLI slice.
design: Deliver v1 as a staged program of work: design the incremental substrate, validate it with schemas and calibration, build a narrow agent-native CLI slice, prove delta review on one active package, then harden the framework. Keep the first CLI surface small but enforce agent-native behavior from the first shipped command.
acceptance_criteria:
- Incremental review substrate is documented and calibrated.
- Review state, claims, evidence, diff reports, impact plans, and delta Drift Surfacer outputs have initial schemas or documented shapes.
- A narrow CLI slice exposes agent-context, skill-path, status, profiles, and feedback with agent-native behavior.
- A delta vertical slice can generate a diff report, impact plan, prompt packet, and delta review artifact for Oathweaver or OverCR.
- CLI behavior is enforced with automated tests for non-interactive execution, parseable JSON, actionable errors, bounded output, and vocabulary consistency.

acceptance_criteria:

- The document separates watch-path impact matches from invalidation-trigger evaluation.
- The document defines agent-native CLI requirements, including agent-context, skill-path, profiles, feedback, vocabulary policy, exit codes, and bounded output.
- The document names framework limits and calibration criteria.

title: Implement git diff report command

design: Implement `repo-review diff --json --no-input`. Support explicit range input, path filters, bounded output, and open classification support. The command should return changed files, summary stats, diff range, classification candidates, and truncation/narrowing hints when output is bounded.
acceptance_criteria:

- Command returns valid JSON with changed files and summary stats.
- Bounded output includes truncation metadata and narrowing hints.
- The command does not prompt in machine mode.

title: Implement impact planner command

Use deterministic `watch_path` matching first; use analyst/LLM-evaluated trigger data if available; keep uncertain mappings visible.

- Output separates path hits, trigger hits, impacted claims, unaffected claims, and unknowns.

title: Add delta Drift Surfacer output
description: Drift Surfacer needs a delta form that can express new, invalidated, strengthened, and weakened observations without pretending a delta review is a full fresh review.
design: Define and test `delta_drift` output with repo, from_review, to_review, diff_range, produced_by_analyzer, new_snapshot_entries, invalidated_snapshot_entries, strengthened_fascination_seeds, weakened_fascination_seeds, new_fascination_seeds, and lane_impacts.
acceptance_criteria:
- `delta_drift` schema or structured shape exists.
- Output can represent new, invalidated, strengthened, and weakened material.
- Output includes analyzer identity.
- Output is tied to the diff range and prior review state.

title: Run delta slice on active package
description: The delta workflow must be proven on either Oathweaver or OverCR because those are the motivating packages and the maintainer wants a CLI-driven workflow soon.
design: Locate or create a prior full review state for either Oathweaver or OverCR. Run the diff report, impact planner, prompt export, external analysis step if needed, and delta Drift Surfacer update. Record friction as feedback entries or follow-up issues.
acceptance_criteria:
- Delta workflow runs on one active package.
- Delta workflow produces diff report, impact plan, prompt packet, delta review artifact, and `delta_drift` output.
- The run identifies any CLI or substrate gaps before broader expansion.

title: Expand agent-native CLI surface
description: After the substrate and delta vertical slice work, repo-review needs a broader composable CLI surface for agents and package maintainers. Expansion should keep vocabulary, introspection, profiles, bounded output, and safe mutation behavior consistent.
design: Add commands for next action selection, ingestion, delta orchestration, claims inspection, async job handling if needed, and delivery sinks. Keep the central command registry as the source of truth.
acceptance_criteria:
- CLI command set expands without violating the agent-native contract.
- `agent-context` remains complete and current.
- Tests enforce vocabulary and output consistency across the expanded command set.

title: Add next ingest and delta commands
description: Agents need higher-level commands after the low-level delta slice works. These commands should remain composable and inspectable rather than hiding all review judgment inside automation.
design: Implement `repo-review next --json`, `ingest --json`, and `delta --json`. `next` returns the next action, required inputs, missing inputs, output path, and recommended command. `ingest` validates and records external analyzer outputs. `delta` either executes analysis or assembles prompt packets depending on the Phase 2 decision.
acceptance_criteria:
- `next --json` returns actionable next-step data.
- `ingest --json` validates external analyzer output and records it.
- `delta --json` reflects the selected v1 orchestration model.
- Whether `repo-review delta` executes analysis itself determines jobs/`--wait` requirements.

title: Add claims CLI commands
description: Claims are the durable review substrate, so agents need direct query commands instead of parsing review-state files manually.
design: Implement `repo-review claims list --json`, `repo-review claims get <id> --json`, and `repo-review claims affected --json`. Support filters for claim_status, kind, subject, and limit. Use fully qualified claim IDs when crossing review states.
acceptance_criteria:
- `claims list` supports filters and bounded output.
- `claims get` retrieves one claim with evidence refs.
- `claims affected` reports claims from an impact plan.
- Commands use scoped claim IDs consistently.

title: Decide and implement async job strategy
description: If repo-review runs long analysis itself, agents need recoverable execution rather than hand-rolled polling. If repo-review only assembles prompt packets in v1, job commands should be deferred explicitly.
design: Decide whether v1 delta commands execute analysis or only assemble prompt packets. If analysis execution ships, implement `--wait` plus a durable local job ledger and `repo-review jobs list|get|prune --json`. If execution is deferred, document the deferral and omit jobs from the shipped command set.
acceptance_criteria:
- Decision is documented in the CLI contract and command registry.
- If jobs ship, job commands return parseable JSON and stable IDs.
- If jobs are deferred, `agent-context` does not advertise unsupported job commands.

title: Add delivery sinks for artifacts
description: Some agent workflows need artifacts on stdout, some need files, and some may later need webhook delivery. Delivery behavior should be explicit and consistent.
design: Add `--deliver=stdout|file:<path>|webhook:<url>` where useful. Keep defaults conservative, avoid implicit overwrites, and return delivery metadata in JSON.
acceptance_criteria:
- Delivery schemes are documented in `agent-context`.
- File delivery requires explicit overwrite behavior for existing paths.
- Stdout delivery remains parseable in JSON mode.
- Webhook delivery is implemented or explicitly deferred.

title: Harden repo-review framework
description: After the incremental substrate and delta workflow are useful, repo-review needs documentation accuracy, helper templates, aggregation support, and extractable patterns to reduce confusion and improve repeated use.
design: Update public docs to match implemented behavior, add self-review hygiene, add helper templates, prototype aggregation over structured review state, and document validated reusable patterns.
acceptance_criteria:
- README reflects implemented behavior rather than aspirational workflow.
- Self-review hygiene exists for repo-review changes.
- Helper templates reduce repeated manual work.
- Aggregation prototype works over v1 review states.
- Extractable patterns are documented only after real use.

title: Rewrite README for implemented behavior
description: The README should describe what repo-review actually supports after v1, not the broader conceptual ambition. Accurate docs matter more once external users are interested in the CLI.
design: Rewrite README sections for workflow, CLI usage, artifact model, full vs delta review, limitations, and example runs. Keep conceptual framing concise and put operational details first.
acceptance_criteria:
- README names implemented commands and artifacts accurately.
- README distinguishes full review, delta review, and non-goals.
- README includes a minimal CLI example for agents and humans.

title: Add repo-review self-review hygiene
description: Once incremental review exists, repo-review should use its own delta workflow when the framework changes. Without self-review hygiene, changes to the review method can drift without durable review memory.
design: Document when repo-review changes should trigger incremental self-review, what artifacts should be updated, and how to avoid contaminating calibration with self-referential review unless intentionally testing the framework.
acceptance_criteria:
- Self-review trigger criteria are documented.
- Required artifacts for framework changes are documented.
- Guidance distinguishes calibration from routine self-review.

title: Add review helper templates
description: Repeated repo-review use will benefit from helper materials that make trace, lift, and twin selection more consistent without adding new analysis passes.
design: Add helper templates for common review decisions, such as selecting affected claims, writing invalidation triggers, summarizing drift, and recording contested claims.
acceptance_criteria:
- Helper templates exist for recurring v1 review tasks.
- Templates are referenced from docs or CLI output where useful.
- Helpers reduce repeated work without expanding the core pass set prematurely.

title: Prototype cross-review aggregation
description: As repo-review produces more structured claims and drift material, users will need ways to compare or aggregate outputs across reviews without modeling cross-repo claim relationships in v1.
design: Prototype aggregation over review states, claim statuses, analyzer identities, diff outcomes, and Drift Surfacer outputs. Keep cross-repo claim identity out of scope unless a later plan explicitly adds it.
acceptance_criteria:
- Aggregation prototype can read multiple review states.
- Output summarizes claim statuses, analyzer identities, and drift material.
- Output does not imply unsupported cross-repo claim identity.

title: Document extractable review patterns
description: Some repo-review patterns may be reusable outside this project, but only patterns validated by real use should be documented as extractables.
design: Identify validated reusable patterns from the incremental review work and document them as extractables. Candidate patterns include enforcement tracing and delta-as-finding, but include only patterns that survived real use.
acceptance_criteria:
- Extractables are based on validated workflow evidence.
- Each extractable explains the reusable pattern and when to apply it.
- Documentation avoids presenting speculative patterns as proven.
